title: Nea Ɔde Ahengua no Ba Ntɛmntɛm
intro: Wɔ sodifo tumidifo bi ahemfie no, wɔhwehwɛɛ biribi a ɛrentumi nyɛ yiye, na pii sii akan sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔn bo yɛ den. Nanso, na obi a ɔne ɔsoro nimdeɛ ntam abusuabɔ boro honam fam ahoɔden nyinaa so nkutoo na obetumi ayɛ adwuma no, na ɔdaa bere tiaa bi a ɛbɛka wɔ mfe no mu adi.
clues: Na mewɔ ɔhene kɛse bi a na ɔno nso yɛ odiyifo som mu, na na migyina ne kuw a na ɔwɔ ne mu ahotoso sen biara no mu.
Na mennyɛ ogya abɔde anaa abɔde a ɔwɔ honam fam ahoɔden kɛse, nanso na mikura biribi a tumi wom koraa.
Bere a ɔhene no srɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa ahengua mfi akyirikyiri asase so mmra no, na minim nea ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mekaa nimdeɛ a na mewɔ fi Nwoma no mu no ho asɛm, na ansa na obiara bɛyɛ n’ade no, wɔde ahengua no sii ɔhene no anim.
Na m’adeyɛ no nnyɛ m’ankasa me tumi, na mmom ɛyɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nokware nimdeɛ firi Allah nko ara hɔ.
Me na mede Seba Hemmaa ahengua baeɛ wɔ aniwa mu, sɛdeɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ Surah An-Naml mu no.

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
